# Central Tech Platform

> All-in-one hub for business & finance management, live crypto/forex/metals market tracking, prayer times, Quran reader, movies, and live sports streaming.

Central Tech Platform (CTP) combines business management tools (expenses, income, inventory, sales, reports) with real-time market data, Islamic utilities, and entertainment in a single multilingual (English, Kurdish, Arabic, Persian, Turkish) web app.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Financial management dashboard — expenses, income, inventory, sales, and PDF reports.
- [Markets](/crypto): Live crypto, forex, and precious metals prices, charts, and signals.
- [Movies](/movies): Movie discovery and streaming.
- [Prayer Times](/prayer): Daily prayer times and Qibla compass.
- [Quran](/quran): Full Quran reader with audio recitation and translations.
- [Reviews](/reviews): User reviews and testimonials.
- [Trust & Security](/trust): How we protect your data and account.

## Optional

- [Trading Bots](/bots): Automated trading bot dashboard (requires account).
